question_and_gold.question: Moses Schorr ministered a significant religious institution in Warsaw. In what year was the official report, compiled by the SS-Gruppenführer responsible for the destruction of that institution, submitted by Poland to the international organization for culture and heritage, for inclusion in their specific program dedicated to documentary heritage?
